current_detector_to_operation_conflation: same transaction inserts confirmed_operation_matches then operator_launch_membership
established_operation_new_member_policy: new proposed members require V1 attribution; operation grandfathering does not apply
shadow_job_trigger: committed candidate/detector result; outside detector transaction
shadow_write_concurrency_model: one compact decision per short independent transaction; retained evidence read before write; no provider in write transaction

lock_contention.basis: in-memory non-production shadow-store tests; no live contention

future_enforcement_boundary: new operation candidates promote only when ATTRIBUTION_PROVEN; existing pre-V1 established statuses remain; new members of established operations require V1
attribution_actionability_boundary_resul: membership/attribution commit precedes prospective actionability capture; actionability is not an operation-validity decision
